AWARD OF SRI LANKA ARMED SERVICES LONG SERVICE MEDAL
IT is hereby notified that the President has been pleased to approve the award of the Armed Services Long Service Medal to the personnel specified in the schedule hereto.
The effective dates of awards to be read as mentioned against each name.

Air Vice Marshal Sampath Thuyacontha (Retd.), WWV, RWP and two Bars, RSP and Bar, USP, MMSc (Strat Stu - China), MSc(Def Stu) in Mgt, MSc(Def & Strat Stu), fndu(China), psc, Secretary, Ministry of Defence.
